notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's ui_pass is a custom sorted-quad render substrate built because bevy_ui could not express the WoW (stratum, level, layer, sublayer, decl) total order. MSUI's UI is ImGui draw lists: painter's-order submission per window plus explicit panel ordering and WowSkin/GameplayArt texture draws achieve the same on-screen layering through a different substrate, and the gamma compositing question is handled by drawing straight into the gamma framebuffer.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Any concrete stratum/level misordering between specific MSUI panels (e.g. DIALOG-strata frames vs foreground draw-list content, which Program.Nameplates.cs already special-cases by suppressing world names under the settings modal) belongs to the individual panel parity entries, not this substrate entry.
